indicator_name: Share of learners who read a short passage
definition: Share of enrolled learners in the fictional town of Westvale who can read a 150-word passage aloud at the end of the spring term.
outcome: Learners can read a short passage aloud

definition: Average hours of one-to-one reading tutoring each enrolled learner in Westvale received during the spring term.
outcome: Time spent in one-to-one reading tutoring

definition: Share of registered learners at the fictional Northwind Cooperative who were present on the first school day of October.
Average number of books each registered learner at Northwind Cooperative finished during the fall term.
Kilowatts of rooftop solar switched on for member households in the fictional district of Bramble during the calendar year.

indicator_name: Greenhouse gas the practice grid avoided
definition: Tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent the fictional Bramble practice grid estimates it avoided during the calendar year, because households used solar.

indicator_name: Battery energy sent to the practice grid
definition: Megawatt-hours the fictional Moss Battery Workshop sent from its demo batteries to the Bramble practice grid during the calendar year.
outcome: Stored electricity sent to the grid

indicator_name: Share of practice-grid electricity from wind
definition: Share of electricity on the fictional Kiln and Current practice grid that came from wind turbines during the calendar year.
